units.source_text: 秀男在面对中院的一间房子里，让千重子看了两幅图案，

en.t: In a room facing the inner courtyard, Hideo showed Chieko two designs,

units.source_text: 一幅是菊花，绿叶扶持，构图清新，几乎看不出是菊叶，看来是下了一番功夫的。

en.t: one of chrysanthemums, supported by green leaves, with a fresh composition in which the chrysanthemum leaves were hardly recognizable; it seemed he had taken considerable pains over it.
The other was of autumn leaves.
